suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects Kotlin compiler build-cache metadata. StarExec only includes this runtime library transitively, through OkHttp, the HTTP client of the Fabric8 Kubernetes client, and does not use Kotlin compilation, Gradle, or a Kotlin build cache. NVD matches the CVE to every Kotlin artifact before 2.4.20 by CPE, but its reviewed GitHub advisory, GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp, lists only kotlin-gradle-plugin.
